title: face_render_signal_check.py — Prompt face-render classifier
purpose: Scores a text-to-video prompt for photorealistic vs. painterly face-render signals. Derived from the finding in art_01M64VKDBYKTJ5C5FYZ35GY6HC r2: with identical props, face rendering language is the deciding variable between a filmed-people read and a painted-face read. Treats an unguided prompt as UNGUIDED (ambiguous), the practical failure mode the article documents.
attribution: Source observation: H01 sampled-frame analysis, art_01M64VKDBYKTJ5C5FYZ35GY6HC r2
Normalisation pattern reused from shot_clause_check.py (memory cc27625e, Forge)
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
